remarks: Please contact listing agent BEFORE completing link to check status of availability. This spacious 3,000 sq. ft. two-story home offers an exceptional layout with four oversized bedrooms, each featuring walk-in closets and generous bathrooms. Enjoy movie nights in the dedicated media room—complete with equipment and furnishings that convey with the home. The first floor also includes a formal dining room, private study, and inviting living spaces filled with natural light. Upstairs, you’ll find a large game room and an additional study nook, ideal for homework or remote work. The expansive backyard provides ample space to add a pool or create your dream outdoor entertaining area. Zoned to top-rated KISD schools and benefiting from a low 2.22% tax rate, this home combines comfort, functionality, and value in one beautiful package.

agents.bio:
Katy native and lifelong resident since the age of 6, I have seen our little town of Katy grow from rice fields and wide open spaces into sprawling masterplanned communities, shopping centers, and award winning schools.... since 1976! Lots of changes but I can assure you there is nothing about this town I don't know. I am the perfect resource to get your current home sold for top dollar or to get you into your new home in this town I call home! 
I thrive on difficult transactions and problem solving. Going through a change of life? Divorce, estate selling, or just wanting a change? I am the seasoned agent you are looking for. Let me earn your business!
